result.title: HADVQ: Hessian Aware Directional Vector Quantization
result.summary: Ultra-low-bit quantization of large language models is a challenging task because aggressive compression severely distorts model parameters and disproportionately harms a small number of highly sensitive channels. We present a vector quantization method tailored for this regime. Our approach begins with random preconditioning, which regularizes the weight space and makes it more amenable to quantization. We then represent weights in polar coordinates and decouple the quantization of directions and magnitudes. To quantize directions, we leverage the structure induced by random preconditioning and design a structured codebook based on the $E_8$ lattice, yielding a compact yet expressive representation. To further reduce degradation, we detect extremely important channels using a proxy Hessian and preserve them with an additional cost of only 0.16 bits. Together, these components provide an effective quantization pipeline for LLMs in the extremely low-bit regime. Empirical results demonstrate improved accuracy, highlighting the benefit of combining geometric structure, lattice-based codebooks, and selective channel preservation.

AI.brief_summary: 论文提出 HADVQ，一种面向大模型超低位宽量化的向量量化流程：先用随机预条件正则化权重空间，再在极坐标下解耦方向与幅值的量化，方向部分用基于 E₈ 格的结构化码本，并以代理 Hessian 识别极敏感通道加以保留（额外约 0.16 bit）。
AI.relevance_reason: 其「方向/幅值解耦 + 格码本 + 敏感通道保留」可能为 LVR 中连续 latent 状态的离散化与任务关键维度保护提供可供核查的压缩思路，但原文只处理权重压缩，与推理期状态生成无直接关系。
